ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food cycle diagram shown, which organism can be classified as a herbivore?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of a food web/food cycle. At the top there are producer labels, such as “Filamentous Algae” and “Diatoms and other Phytoplankton”. On the left there is an organism labeled “Stonerollers”; in the figure, arrows point to it from plant-based sources such as algae or phytoplankton. Reasoning: Herbivores are animals that feed on plants, algae, or other producers. Because in the figure Stonerollers receive feeding arrows from algae/phytoplankton, they can be classified as herbivores. Therefore the answer is Stoneroller.
